capabilities: Store credentials in encrypted category columns
Reorder cards, columns and fields by dragging
Generate passwords and copy field values
Lock the database on focus loss or inactivity
disambiguation: Not a task Kanban board; it only uses a Kanban layout to organize encrypted login credentials.
extras: No import, export, automatic backups or master-password change in this version; a forgotten master password cannot be recovered and the plugin has not had an independent security audit.
problem: Obsidian has no secure place for passwords, so credentials kept in plain notes or Markdown files stay exposed.
summary: Encrypted, category-based password manager that stores credentials as cards on a Kanban board in Obsidian.
